artworks.title: Portrait of a Boy with Hoop
artworks.artist: Albert Sands Southworth Josiah Johnson Hawes

artworks.title: Portrait of a Mother Nursing Baby
artworks.description: The image displays a woman holding a baby while seated. The woman looks at the camera with a neutral expression. She has discernible facial features, parted and pulled back hair, and wears a dark outer garment over a patterned dress or blouse. The baby is wrapped in light fabric with their face and hand visible. There are no visible jewelry or objects held by the woman. The background is plain, and the image is framed with gold borders.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl and Dog
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a young girl seated with her arm resting on a long-haired dog lying beside her. The girl has long wavy hair that falls past her shoulders and frames her face. Her facial features are soft, with a serene expression. She is wearing a loose-fitting light-colored dress with visible folds, adorned with floral patterns. The background is plain, allowing full focus on the girl and her dog. The photograph is presented in an ornate frame with a gold-colored inner border and red and gold outer border.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Sleeping Cat
artworks.description: In this grayscale photograph, a cat lies on top of a small table covered with a patterned cloth. The cat is on its side, its head towards the right and its tail towards the left. Its eyes are closed. The photograph is an elongated octagon, and around its edges are some areas of dark brown and blueish discoloration. Around the photograph is a rectangular gold frame, and beyond that is a thin maroon border.

artworks.title: Portrait of a School Group
artworks.description: The image displays a sepia-toned, oval photograph of a large group portrait comprised of men, women, and children. They are visible from at least the waist up, arranged with some individuals seated in the front and others standing behind them, including several people on a stairway to the left. Many of them are dressed in period attire, with men in dark suits and women in dresses covering their shoulders and extending long sleeves, along with hats worn by some. The men have short hair or wear hats, while the women's hair is styled in buns, curls, or parted with curls on their faces. Some women and girls wear shawls or capes. The photograph is framed in an elaborate black wooden frame with beaded detailing and a gold embossed inner border. The background features a plain draped cloth suggesting an indoor or constructed setting for the group portrait.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Brother and Postmortem Sister
artworks.description: This grayscale photograph shows two children sitting closely together. The boy on the right has his arm around the girl on the left. The boy has short, dark hair and a neutral expression as he looks out at us. He is dressed in a dark suit with a white shirt and a black bow tie. The girl has light-colored hair styled away from her face. Her eyes are closed, and her mouth looks partially open. She is wearing a light-colored dress with a necklace featuring a round pendant. Her limbs are very thin. The background is plain. The photo is surrounded by an ornate, gold-toned decorative frame.

artworks.title: William Pepper Norris
artworks.description: The image portrays a young child seated in a formal pose. The child is sitting on a red velvet chair with wood carvings visible on the top. Their face has fair skin and light-colored hair. They are wearing a dark velvet outfit with white lace or frill, light trousers, and shoes that match the trousers. The child is holding a small hat. The setting seems to be a studio with a neutral backdrop. The portrait is in a round gilded frame with intricate detailing.

artworks.title: "Charles Aaron and His Cat"
artworks.description: The image shows a young girl standing next to a piece of furniture covered with a patterned cloth, upon which a cat is resting. Her hair is neatly combed and parted to the side. She is wearing a dark patterned dress with a white lace collar. The girl is resting her hand on the furniture where the cat lies. The background of the image is plain and the photograph is set in an ornate gold-colored frame with scalloped edges.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Boy and Cat
artworks.description: The image shows a boy seated on a chair, holding a cat in his lap. He has short dark hair, is dressed in a dark outfit with a white collar, and has a solemn expression. The cat looks calm. The background is plain, and the image is enclosed in a gold-colored ornate frame.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl and Cat
artworks.creditLine: The Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Gifted in Memory of Earl J. "Jerry" Coates

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl and Cat
artworks.description: The image shows a girl seated in a wooden chair, with a straight posture and hands on her lap. She has delicate features, straight hair, and is wearing a long-sleeved dress with circular patterns and fringes. She is cradling a dark-colored rabbit in her lap. The background is a plain studio setting.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Child and Cat
artworks.description: The image depicts a young person from the waist up, seated and facing the camera. They have a serene expression and a slight smile, with dark hair styled neatly. The individual wears a patterned, checked dress with a high neckline and holds a small animal in their lap. The background is plain, and the image is framed with an ornate gold-colored oval frame within a larger red-lined rectangle.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl and Cat
artworks.description: The image shows a young girl seated outdoors with a black cat on her lap. She wears a light-colored dress with dark circular patterns, dark leggings, and high-ankle boots. The background includes a tree trunk, bushes, and sunlight casting shadows on the ground.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Kitten
artworks.description: The image shows a kitten inside a circular metal structure. The kitten is positioned near the edge of the opening, looking upwards. Its fur is primarily white with some darker patches, particularly on one ear and part of its face. The metal structure is cylindrical with a smooth finish. The background is blurred, emphasizing the kitten. The photograph is mounted on a decorative backing and labeled "Yung Fong, Shanghai."

artworks.title: Portrait of a Cigar Maker
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, seated and facing slightly to the left. His posture is relaxed with one hand resting on a table and the other on his lap. He has dark hair that is styled in waves, along with a neatly groomed mustache. He is dressed in a light-colored shirt with intricate detailing, a dark vest, and a bow tie. In front of him, there is a table covered with a patterned cloth, and a small pile of leaves or greenery is visible. The background is plain, and the photo is set in a decorative frame with intricate designs around its edge.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Tinsmith
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man seated in a three-quarter view. The man is positioned side-on to the camera, with his body turned slightly towards the viewer, while his head remains turned towards the camera. He has a fair complexion, a clean-shaven face with defined cheekbones, and a strong jawline, while his hair is medium length, dark, and slicked back beneath a tall top hat. He wears a light-colored shirt underneath a darker pinstriped apron, with a scarf or cravat tied around his neck. His right hand is holding an object that appears to be garden shears or a similar tool, and his left hand rests on a surface in front of him. Surrounding him on the table are various tools or objects that provide a sense of his working environment. The background is plain and light-colored, focusing attention on the subject. The entire image is framed by an ornate, gold-colored mount within a red border.

artworks.title: Samuel Morse Felton Steam Engine and Crew, Fitchburg, Massachusetts
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a steam locomotive on train tracks. The locomotive is centered, showcasing its design with visible parts including large wheels, a smokestack, and machinery. The photograph is in a decorative frame with gold embellishments and rounded arches. The background shows part of a train station or shed. The image represents the industrial period and 19th-century steam transportation.

artworks.title: Portrait of Bobbin Boys
artworks.description: The image shows two young boys in a half-body portrait, standing side by side and facing the camera. Both boys have round faces with short, dark hair that is neatly combed. They are dressed in loose-fitting, light-colored shirts with long sleeves and high collars, each wearing a sturdy white apron over their shirts. They have similar dark trousers, and one of the boys holds a small metallic container with a lid in his right hand. There is no visible jewelry. The background is simple and dark, providing a stark contrast that emphasizes the boys and their clothing. The image is bordered by an ornate, gold-colored frame with intricate patterns.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Phrenologist
artworks.description: The image shows a woman depicted from the waist up, sitting in a formal position. She has a composed expression with clearly defined facial features and her dark hair is styled into a smooth bun, covered partially by a white headpiece. She is wearing a dark, long-sleeved dress with a high neckline, accented by a white lace collar. The woman is holding a small sculpted bust in her right hand, which rests on a table covered with decorative fabric. The background is a simple dark backdrop. The image is framed in an ornate gold mat within a red-bordered frame, with the name "WALSH" imprinted at the bottom.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Dry Goods Salesman
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing behind a table or counter. He has short dark hair and is dressed in a formal outfit with a waistcoat over a light-colored shirt and a bow tie. The man is handling a piece of fabric and there are shelves with fabric bolts behind him. The image is in an ornate golden frame with floral and geometric designs.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Housekeeper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman from the waist up. She has her hands resting on a large broom in front of her. She has a composed expression, dark hair neatly parted in the middle, and is wearing a patterned long-sleeved dress with a high collar and a light-colored apron over it. The surroundings include an ornately patterned fabric draped over a seating surface. The frame around the image is richly decorated with floral and scroll motifs. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Washwoman
artworks.description: This is a full-body portrait of a woman standing in a slight three-quarter view. Her hands are positioned on her waist and by her side, with a slight lean to her left. She has a neutral expression and her eyes are looking directly at the camera. Her hair is styled in a mid-19th-century fashion, with a middle part and some waves. She wears a checked dress with a fitted bodice and a full skirt, typical of the era. The sleeves of her dress are short with ruffles at the edges. She stands next to a wooden chair that holds a wooden bucket and some cloth items. Her feet are clad in dark shoes peeking out from under her dress. The background is plain, possibly a painted backdrop, with no discernible features, and the floor is covered in a patterned textile. The image is enclosed within an ornate gilded frame featuring intricate floral designs.
